verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a processor, so a built-in AI assistant you delegate tasks to is a software-product axis that does not fit this kind of hardware. The evidence shows only developer tooling for running models on the chip (ONNX Runtime, Lemonade SDK, and GAIA, an open-source framework for building local agents). None of these is an assistant built into the product itself.
